title: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
subtitle: Hsu Shui Lou, Building for Gathering the Waters · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: reservoir house, two storeys: 10 × 8 m, eave 6.5 m, ridge 9 m
north wing, one storey (size a guess): 8 × 6 m, eave 3.5 m, ridge 5 m

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 3 per S02. Small 2-storey with a northern 1-storey wing (S02). Holds 养水池, 轧水机 (S06).
